Traffic Advisory: Due to government work on January 20, 2026, special traffic arrangements will be in place from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Traffic restrictions and diversions will be in effect on both carriageways and service roads around W Point, A Point (ITO Chowk), BSZ Marg, DDU Marg, Mirdard Road, Mirdard Red Light, and Press Road. Commuters are advised to avoid the affected routes, use alternative routes, park only in designated areas, and follow the instructions of the traffic police.

Illegally parked vehicles will be towed, and legal action will be taken.

 #DPTrafficAdvisory
 #DelhiTrafficPolice
